# Dylan Grosz

> ML Scientist at Apple specializing in speaker recognition and voice trigger for Siri, serving 1B+ active devices across 40+ locales. Stanford '20. 90 research citations. Patent pending.

## About
- Stanford University, B.S. Symbolic Systems (AI concentration), 2020
- On-device ML across 6 Apple platforms (iPhone, Mac, HomePod, Apple TV, Apple Watch, Vision Pro), 40+ locales, 1B+ active devices
- Specialization: speaker recognition, voice trigger, model evaluation, Bayesian optimization, fairness in ML
- U.S. Patent Application 20220383324 (predictive autoscaling via sequence modeling)
